title: Resignation of registered agent.
bodyText: A registered agent may resign from the registered agent's appointment by complying with the requirements of section 425R-10.
bodyHtml: §425-20  Resignation of registered agent.  A registered agent may resign from the registered agent's appointment by complying with the requirements of section 425R-10. [L 2002, c 130, pt of §5; am L 2009, c 55, §34]
